instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium close-up, eye-level shot captures a cozy, warm indoor living room during the day. The elderly man in a striped shirt (R1) sits on the right, facing forward with a gentle smile and his hand on his chest. Beside him, the elderly woman in a white shirt (R2) wearing glasses sits on the left, leaning her head affectionately on his shoulder with a warm smile. On the far right, a cropped bystander's arm rests on the man's shoulder. Soft, warm indoor lighting and natural light from a window illuminate the scene, creating a gentle, intimate mood with a soft depth of field.
